operator_notes: Real PDF files behind mDocs download links (?mdocs-file=NNNN, served with Content-Disposition: attachment) — click Download, then capture PDF. Never Save page as PDF.
mDocs table on /bulletins/ — latest PDF is always the first row/first download link in DOM order.
Site can take 3–5 minutes to show the table — harvest budget is up to 10 minutes.
PDF href is on the Download link, not the homepage.
operator_notes_2026_08_09: 2026-08-09 fix: (1) the site's SSL certificate has been renewed (valid to 2026-10-22) and HTTP now hard-redirects to HTTPS, so the old 'HTTP only' workaround broke the harvest (ERR_ABORTED on the forced https redirect) — switched start_url/goto back to https://.

(2) the mDocs plugin markup changed: the table itself no longer has class 'mdocs' (it's now a plain Bootstrap table.table-hover.table-condensed nested inside a wrapping div.mdocs), so 'table.mdocs tbody tr:first-child a[href*=.pdf]' never matched and wait_for_selector burned the full budget. Primary selector is now the plugin-structure-independent a[href*='mdocs-file'], which is still first-in-DOM-order = newest; old selectors kept as fallbacks in case the theme reverts.
Verified live: first mdocs-file link is 9507 = '09 August 2026.pdf' (current target week), confirmed via direct HTTP fetch (Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="09 August 2026.pdf").
do_not: Do not use Save page as PDF — bulletins are downloadable PDF files, not HTML text.
